This plan defines roles, responsibilities, and reporting lines for Lumina 2025 festival staff. It is the single reference for staffing decisions and supersedes all prior verbal agreements. # VENUE CAPACITY SHEET – LUMINA 2025

**Document ID:** LUM-CAP-2025  
**Version:** 6.1  
**Effective Date:** 17 Aug 2025  
**Owner:** Lumina Production Team  
**Classification:** Internal – Operations & Safety

---

### 1. SUMMARY OF VENUES

The following table lists all ticketed and non-ticketed venues for Lumina 2025. Capacity figures are operational limits approved by the Singapore Civil Defence Force (SCDF) and the Land Transport Authority (LTA) where applicable. All figures are in whole numbers and reflect the maximum number of persons permitted within the defined perimeter at any one time.

| Venue ID | Venue Name | Capacity (people) | Status | Last Verified | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| ENT01 | Harbour Stage | 3,200 | Current | 15 Aug 2025 | Rear barrier shifted outward; improved crowd flow. |
| ENT02 | Marina Lawn | 1,800 | Current | 15 Aug 2025 | General admission; no seating. |
| ENT03 | Aurora Stage | 5,000 | Current | 15 Aug 2025 | Approved operational limit after final fence layout. |
| ENT04 | Echo Tent | 2,000 | Current | 17 Aug 2025 | Wheelchair-accessible seating confirmed. |
| ENT05 | East Loop Tent | 900 | Current | 15 Aug 2025 | Emergency lighting checked; battery backup OK. |
| ENT06 | Sunset Deck | 120 | Current | 15 Aug 2025 | Not ticketed; staff only. |

**Note on ENT04:** Echo Tent capacity is documented as 2000 people in the capacity sheet. Record status: current. This remains the approved operational limit as of 17 Aug 2025. No change has been made to this figure since the 30 Jun 2025 correction.

---

### 2. ACCESSIBILITY AND CROWD FLOW NOTES

The following notes supplement the capacity figures above. They are based on site inspections conducted on 15 and 17 Aug 2025.

#### 2.1 Accessibility

- **Echo Tent (ENT04):** Two wheelchair-accessible entry points are located at the north and south ends of the tent. Both are clearly marked and free of obstructions. A designated viewing area for wheelchair users is positioned 15 m from the stage, with a clear line of sight.
- **Harbour Stage (ENT01):** Ramps at the east and west entrances have a gradient of 1:12, compliant with BCA guidelines. Handrails are installed on both sides.
- **Aurora Stage (ENT03):** Accessible toilets are located 50 m from the main entrance. The route is paved and lit.
- **East Loop Tent (ENT05):** The tent floor is level with the adjacent walkway. No steps are present at any entrance.
- **Sunset Deck (ENT06):** Staff-only venue. Not required to meet public accessibility standards.

#### 2.2 Crowd Flow

- **Echo Tent (ENT04):** Entry is via two gated points (north and south). Exit is via four emergency exits, two on each side. During peak periods, one-way flow is enforced: enter from the north, exit to the south. This is managed by crowd control staff stationed at each gate.
- **Harbour Stage (ENT01):** Rear barrier has been shifted 2 m outward to widen the through-route behind the viewing area. This reduces congestion between sets.
- **Aurora Stage (ENT03):** The main entrance opens onto a 10 m wide corridor. No pinch points identified. Exit gates are numbered 1–12 and are tested weekly.
- **Marina Lawn (ENT02):** Open field with no fixed barriers. Crowd control is via perimeter fencing and staff patrols. No dedicated entry gates; access is via four openings spaced evenly along the fence line.
- **East Loop Tent (ENT05):** Single entrance and exit at the west end. Capacity is limited to 900 to allow for safe egress in the event of an emergency.
- **Sunset Deck (ENT06):** Staff-only. Access is via a keycard-controlled door at the base of the deck stairs.

#### 2.3 Known Constraints

- **Echo Tent (ENT04):** The tent structure has a central support pole that obstructs sightlines from a 3 m radius around it. This area is not ticketed and is used for equipment storage during performances.
- **Aurora Stage (ENT03):** The viewing area slopes gently downward toward the stage. The slope gradient is 1:20, within acceptable limits. No terracing is installed.
- **Harbour Stage (ENT01):** The rear barrier is movable and is repositioned based on expected crowd size. The current position (2 m outward) reflects the 15 Aug 2025 inspection.

Revision: 6
Last updated: 17 Aug 2025, 14:20 hrs
Next scheduled review: after closing inspection, 19 Aug 2025

This sheet consolidates venue capacities, site-wide limits, and crowd-flow constraints for Lumina 2025. Figures are based on the 15 Aug 2025 site inspection unless otherwise noted. All capacities are in whole numbers and refer to concurrent occupancy unless stated. Any change to a venue layout triggers a re-issue of this sheet.

1. SITE-WIDE CAPACITY

Total site capacity: 42,000 pax. This is the maximum number of persons (audience, staff, performers, vendors, and crew combined) permitted on the festival grounds at any one time. The figure is set by the Building and Construction Authority (BCA) under the Public Entertainments Licence and is not subject to operational adjustment.

Breakdown by zone (for planning only; zone figures are not independently licensed):

- Festival Village (north end): 12,500 pax
- Marina Lawn and Harbour Stage viewing area: 14,000 pax
- Aurora Stage viewing area and surrounding lawns: 9,500 pax
- East Loop Tent and adjacent food alley: 2,000 pax
- Echo Tent: 1,800 pax
- Staff-only zones (Sunset Deck, production compound, back-of-house corridors): 2,200 pax
- Circulation and transition spaces (walkways, plazas, queue zones): remainder

The sum of zone figures exceeds the total site capacity by design. Zone figures are for local crowd management and do not authorise exceeding the 42,000-pax site limit.

2. EVACUATION ROUTES

The site has four primary evacuation routes, each terminating at a designated muster point outside the perimeter fence. All routes are kept clear of obstructions at all times. During an evacuation, audio announcements and marshals direct attendees to the nearest route; routes are not interchangeable mid-evacuation.

- Route A (north): Runs from the Festival Village along the main service road to Muster Point A (North Gate car park). Width: 8 m. Capacity: 1,200 pax/min at walking pace.
- Route B (east): From the East Loop Tent and food alley along the eastern service lane to Muster Point B (East Gate overflow lot). Width: 6 m. Capacity: 900 pax/min.
- Route C (south): From the Marina Lawn and Harbour Stage viewing area across the lawn to Muster Point C (South Gate). Width: 12 m across open ground. Capacity: 1,800 pax/min.
- Route D (west): From the Aurora Stage viewing area along the west perimeter path to Muster Point D (West Gate). Width: 5 m. Capacity: 700 pax/min.

Evacuation routes are inspected daily at 09:00 hrs and after any weather event exceeding 50 mm of rainfall in a 6-hour period. The 15 Aug 2025 inspection confirmed all routes clear and all muster point signage legible.

3. VENUE CAPACITIES (BY VENUE)

3.1 Harbour Stage (ENT01)

- Licensed capacity: 14,000 pax (including viewing area and overflow lawn)
- Viewing area (fenced): 11,500 pax
- Overflow lawn (rear, unfenced): 2,500 pax; opened only when viewing area reaches 90% occupancy
- Stage front barrier: fixed, 1.2 m high, with 4 m clearance between barrier and stage edge
- Rear barrier: movable; repositioned based on expected crowd size. Current position (2 m outward from the default line) was set at the 15 Aug 2025 inspection and reflects the expected crowd for the 16 Aug headliner. The rear barrier is not to be moved further outward without approval from the Operations Manager and the Safety Officer.
- Entry: two gated points (north and south), each 3 m wide, staffed during all performances
- Exit: four emergency exits, two per side, each 2.5 m wide, kept unlocked and unobstructed at all times
